Next step: we recommend a 30-minute product demo + brief technical Q&A to show how Redwood would fit into your flow and discuss integration patterns. Can you confirm which of the following slots work for the core group (Sara + Platform engineer + you)? I can include a short agenda and a one-pager.

Option A: Thu Apr 2, 2026 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT (17:00 UTC)
Option B: Thu Apr 2, 2026 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT (21:00 UTC)
Option C: Fri Apr 3, 2026 — 9:00–9:30 AM PT (16:00 UTC)

If none of those work, please propose 2 alternatives and confirm who will attend from your side (name + role). We’ll invite: myself (Solutions), Vanessa (Sales lead) and Jonas (Platform engineer) to cover ops-level questions.

Attached: Redwood one-pager and proposed 30-min agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to lining something up.
